content.name: Karthik Raghunathan
content.title: Senior Customer Service Representative
content.summary: Customer service representative with nine years in telecom, health insurance and fintech support in Bengaluru. Resolves escalated payment and KYC issues for a digital lending app, trains new joiners in English, Hindi, Kannada and Tamil, and helped bring grievance resolution time down from five days to two.

experience.title: Customer Care Executive
bullets: Handled around 100 inbound calls a day on prepaid recharges, postpaid bills and network complaints in four languages.
Exceeded the monthly quality target in 26 of 30 months and was moved to the postpaid priority queue in my second year.
Logged network complaints with location details for the technical team, helping them spot three repeat-fault towers.

experience.title: Customer Service Representative
bullets: Guided policyholders and hospital desks through cashless claim approvals, documents and claim status, often on urgent admissions.
Cut pending pre-authorisation queries by setting up a daily follow-up list with the medical team.
Trained 22 new joiners on the claims system and IRDAI-aligned grievance process during the pandemic hiring drive.
Kept a customer satisfaction score of 88% during the second COVID-19 wave, when daily volumes doubled.

experience.title: Senior Customer Service Representative
bullets: Resolve escalated cases on failed UPI payments, EMI deductions and KYC rejections for a lending app with 1.2 million users.
Worked with operations on a grievance tracker that reduced average resolution time from five days to two.
Coach a group of nine executives, reviewing calls weekly and building a Kannada and Tamil script library.
Prepare the weekly complaints summary for the grievance redressal officer, flagging RBI-reportable cases on time.

achievements.title: Customer Champion award
achievements.detail: Received at Cubbon Fintech in 2024 for the highest customer satisfaction score among senior representatives.

achievements.title: Pandemic trainer
achievements.detail: Onboarded and trained 22 executives remotely at Nandi Health Insurance TPA.
